t: Did you get a present for your sister?
lines.plain: Did you get a present for your sister?
lines.kana: Did you get a present for your sister?
lines.zh: 你買到送你妹妹的禮物了嗎？
lines.en: Did you get a present for your sister?
lines.zh-Hans: 你买到送你妹妹的礼物了吗？

t: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.
lines.plain: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.
lines.kana: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.
lines.zh: 買了。本來想買書給她，可是她書太多了。後來看到一條很漂亮的圍巾，但太貴了，所以最後買了一條項鍊。
lines.en: Yes. I was going to buy her a book, but she's got so many. Then I saw a lovely scarf, but it was too expensive, so I got her a necklace in the end.
lines.zh-Hans: 买了。本来想买书给她，可是她书太多了。后来看到一条很漂亮的围巾，但太贵了，所以最后买了一条项链。

t: What did the boy buy for his sister?
q.plain: What did the boy buy for his sister?
q.kana: What did the boy buy for his sister?
q.en: What did the boy buy for his sister?

explain.zh: 書她太多、圍巾太貴，「最後買了一條項鍊」。
explain.en: Too many books, the scarf too expensive: a necklace in the end.
explain.zh-Hans: 书她太多、围巾太贵，「最后买了一条项链」。

t: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?
lines.plain: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?
lines.kana: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?
lines.zh: 你要搭計程車去機場嗎？
lines.en: Are you taking a taxi to the airport?
lines.zh-Hans: 你要搭出租车去机场吗？

t: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.
lines.plain: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.
lines.kana: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.
lines.zh: 不要，太貴了。我搭火車，比公車快。
lines.en: No, they're too expensive. I'll get the train — it's quicker than the bus.
lines.zh-Hans: 不要，太贵了。我搭火车，比公车快。

t: How will the woman get to the airport?
q.plain: How will the woman get to the airport?
q.kana: How will the woman get to the airport?
q.en: How will the woman get to the airport?

explain.zh: 計程車太貴，「我搭火車，比公車快」。
explain.en: Taxis are too expensive; the train is quicker than the bus.
explain.zh-Hans: 出租车太贵，「我搭火车，比公车快」。

t: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?
lines.plain: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?
lines.kana: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?
lines.zh: 我們星期六去海邊好嗎？
lines.en: Shall we go to the beach on Saturday?
lines.zh-Hans: 我们星期六去海边好吗？

t: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.
lines.plain: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.
lines.kana: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.
lines.zh: 氣象預報說早上會下雨，但整個下午都是晴天。
lines.en: The forecast says it'll rain in the morning, but it'll be sunny all afternoon.
lines.zh-Hans: 气象预报说早上会下雨，但整个下午都是晴天。

t: Great — let's go after lunch, then.
lines.plain: Great — let's go after lunch, then.
lines.kana: Great — let's go after lunch, then.
lines.zh: 太好了，那我們吃完午飯再去。
lines.en: Great — let's go after lunch, then.
lines.zh-Hans: 太好了，那我们吃完午饭再去。

t: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?
q.plain: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?
q.kana: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?
q.zh: 星期六下午天氣會怎麼樣？
q.en: What will the weather be like on Saturday afternoon?
q.zh-Hans: 星期六下午天气会怎么样？

explain.zh: 早上下雨，「整個下午都是晴天」。
explain.en: Rain in the morning, sunny all afternoon.
explain.zh-Hans: 早上下雨，「整个下午都是晴天」。

t: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.
lines.plain: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.
lines.kana: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.
lines.zh: 你有看到我的眼鏡嗎？我以為放在包包裡。
lines.en: Have you seen my glasses? I thought they were in my bag.
lines.zh-Hans: 你有看到我的眼镜吗？我以为放在包包里。

t: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.
lines.plain: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.
lines.kana: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.
lines.zh: 在廚房的桌子上，報紙旁邊。
lines.en: They're on the kitchen table, next to the newspaper.
lines.zh-Hans: 在厨房的桌子上，报纸旁边。

explain.zh: 他以為在包包裡，但其實「在廚房的桌子上」。
explain.en: He thought in his bag, but they are on the kitchen table.
explain.zh-Hans: 他以为在包包里，但其实「在厨房的桌子上」。

t: Did you play tennis at the weekend?
lines.plain: Did you play tennis at the weekend?
lines.kana: Did you play tennis at the weekend?
lines.zh: 你週末有去打網球嗎？
lines.en: Did you play tennis at the weekend?
lines.zh-Hans: 你周末有去打网球吗？

t: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.
lines.plain: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.
lines.kana: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.
lines.zh: 沒有，風太大了，所以我們改去游泳。下週末我們要去聽演唱會。
lines.en: No, it was too windy, so we went swimming instead. We're going to a concert next weekend.
lines.zh-Hans: 没有，风太大了，所以我们改去游泳。下周末我们要去听演唱会。

t: What did the girl do at the weekend?
q.plain: What did the girl do at the weekend?
q.kana: What did the girl do at the weekend?
q.en: What did the girl do at the weekend?

explain.zh: 風太大沒打網球，「改去游泳」；演唱會是下週末。
explain.en: Too windy for tennis, so swimming; the concert is next weekend.
explain.zh-Hans: 风太大没打网球，「改去游泳」；演唱会是下周末。

t: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.
lines.plain: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.
lines.kana: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.
lines.zh: 大家好。我要跟大家說下個月去科學博物館的校外教學。我們五月十四日星期四出發——不是我之前說的星期五。遊覽車八點半從學校出發，所以請在八點二十分以前到停車場。這次活動十二英鎊，包含在博物館咖啡廳的午餐。要帶筆記本和一支筆，因為要寫學習單。還有別忘了穿好走的鞋子，我們會走很多路。有問題請寄電子郵件給我。我是格林老師，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N。
lines.en: Hello, everyone. I want to tell you about next month's trip to the science museum. We're going on Thursday the fourteenth of May — not Friday, as I said before. The coach will leave the school at half past eight, so please be in the car park by twenty past. The trip costs twelve pounds, and that includes lunch at the museum café. You'll need to bring a notebook and a pen, because there's a worksheet to complete. And don't forget to wear comfortable shoes — we'll be walking a lot. If you have any questions, please email me. My name is Mrs Green — that's G-R-E-E-N.
lines.zh-Hans: 大家好。我要跟大家说下个月去科学博物馆的校外教学。我们五月十四日星期四出发——不是我之前说的星期五。游览车八点半从学校出发，所以请在八点二十分以前到停车场。这次活动十二英镑，包含在博物馆咖啡厅的午餐。要带笔记本和一支笔，因为要写学习单。还有别忘了穿好走的鞋子，我们会走很多路。有问题请寄电子邮件给我。我是格林老师，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N。

ask.zh: 出發日期：＿＿ 5 月 14 日
ask.zh-Hans: 出发日期：＿＿ 5 月 14 日

explain.zh: 「五月十四日星期四——不是我之前說的星期五」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「五月十四日星期四——不是我之前说的星期五」。

explain.zh: 「遊覽車八點半從學校出發」；八點二十分是要到停車場的時間。
explain.en: It leaves at 8.30; be there by 8.20.
explain.zh-Hans: 「游览车八点半从学校出发」；八点二十分是要到停车场的时间。

explain.zh: 「這次活動十二英鎊」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「这次活动十二英镑」。

explain.zh: 「要帶筆記本和一支筆」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「要带笔记本和一支笔」。

explain.zh: 「我是格林老師，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「我是格林老师，拼法是 G-R-E-E-N」。

t: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?
lines.plain: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?
lines.kana: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?
lines.zh: 嗨，艾瑪！新工作怎麼樣？
lines.en: Hi Emma! How's the new job going?
lines.zh-Hans: 嗨，艾玛！新工作怎么样？

t: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.
lines.plain: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.
lines.kana: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.
lines.zh: 很好，謝謝。我在電影院工作三個星期了。
lines.en: Really well, thanks. I've been working at the cinema for three weeks now.
lines.zh-Hans: 很好，谢谢。我在电影院工作三个星期了。

lines.plain: What do you do there?
lines.kana: What do you do there?
lines.zh: 你在那裡做什麼？
lines.en: What do you do there?
lines.zh-Hans: 你在那里做什么？

t: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.
lines.plain: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.
lines.kana: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.
lines.zh: 大部分時間在賣票，有時候也在咖啡吧幫忙做爆米花和飲料。
lines.en: Mostly I sell tickets, but sometimes I help in the café, making popcorn and drinks.
lines.zh-Hans: 大部分时间在卖票，有时候也在咖啡吧帮忙做爆米花和饮料。

t: Do you get to watch the films for free?
lines.plain: Do you get to watch the films for free?
lines.kana: Do you get to watch the films for free?
lines.zh: 你可以免費看電影嗎？
lines.en: Do you get to watch the films for free?
lines.zh-Hans: 你可以免费看电影吗？

t: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!
lines.plain: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!
lines.kana: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!
lines.zh: 可以，星期一員工想看哪部都可以。上週我看了新的太空片，超好看，但滿長的，將近三個小時！
lines.en: Yes — on Mondays, staff can see any film they like. Last week I saw the new space film. It was brilliant, but quite long — nearly three hours!
lines.zh-Hans: 可以，星期一员工想看哪部都可以。上周我看了新的太空片，超好看，但满长的，将近三个小时！

lines.plain: What are your hours like?
lines.kana: What are your hours like?
lines.zh: 你的上班時間怎麼樣？
lines.en: What are your hours like?
lines.zh-Hans: 你的上班时间怎么样？

t: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.
lines.plain: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.
lines.kana: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.
lines.zh: 星期五和星期六晚上，六點到十一點。我在存錢，暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙。
lines.en: I work on Friday and Saturday evenings, from six until eleven. And I'm saving up to go to Spain with my cousins in the summer.
lines.zh-Hans: 星期五和星期六晚上，六点到十一点。我在存钱，暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙。

t: How long has Emma worked at the cinema?
ask.plain: How long has Emma worked at the cinema?
ask.zh: 艾瑪在電影院工作多久了？
ask.en: How long has Emma worked at the cinema?
ask.zh-Hans: 艾玛在电影院工作多久了？

explain.zh: 「我在電影院工作三個星期了」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「我在电影院工作三个星期了」。

t: What does Emma do most of the time?
ask.plain: What does Emma do most of the time?
ask.zh: 艾瑪大部分時間做什麼？
ask.en: What does Emma do most of the time?
ask.zh-Hans: 艾玛大部分时间做什么？

explain.zh: 「大部分時間在賣票」，做爆米花只是有時候。
explain.zh-Hans: 「大部分时间在卖票」，做爆米花只是有时候。

t: When can staff see films for free?
ask.plain: When can staff see films for free?
ask.zh: 員工什麼時候可以免費看電影？
ask.en: When can staff see films for free?
ask.zh-Hans: 员工什么时候可以免费看电影？

explain.zh: 「星期一員工想看哪部都可以」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「星期一员工想看哪部都可以」。

t: What did Emma think of the space film?
ask.plain: What did Emma think of the space film?
ask.zh: 艾瑪覺得那部太空片怎麼樣？
ask.en: What did Emma think of the space film?
ask.zh-Hans: 艾玛觉得那部太空片怎么样？

explain.zh: 「超好看」（brilliant），而且很長，不是太短。
explain.zh-Hans: 「超好看」（brilliant），而且很长，不是太短。

explain.zh: 「暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙」：為了旅行。
explain.zh-Hans: 「暑假要和表姊妹去西班牙」：为了旅行。

t: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.
lines.plain: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.
lines.kana: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位女士談一家餐廳。
lines.en: You will hear a woman talking about a restaurant.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一位女士谈一家餐厅。

t: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.
lines.plain: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.
lines.kana: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.
lines.zh: 羅莎餐廳的菜很好吃，服務生也很親切。唯一的問題是不太好找，在車站後面的一條小街上。
lines.en: The food at Rosa's is lovely, and the waiters are really friendly. The only problem is that it's quite hard to find — it's down a little street behind the station.
lines.zh-Hans: 罗莎餐厅的菜很好吃，服务生也很亲切。唯一的问题是不太好找，在车站后面的一条小街上。

t: What does the woman say about the restaurant?
ask.plain: What does the woman say about the restaurant?
ask.en: What does the woman say about the restaurant?

explain.zh: 「唯一的問題是不太好找」；服務生很親切，地點在車站後面。
explain.en: Hard to find; friendly waiters; behind the station.
explain.zh-Hans: 「唯一的问题是不太好找」；服务生很亲切，地点在车站后面。

t: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.
lines.plain: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.
lines.kana: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個男孩和媽媽說話。
lines.en: You will hear a boy talking to his mother.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一个男孩和妈妈说话。

t: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.
lines.plain: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.
lines.kana: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.
lines.zh: 媽，可以借你的筆電嗎？我的壞了，今晚要把歷史作業做完。
lines.en: Mum, can I borrow your laptop? Mine is broken, and I need to finish my history project tonight.
lines.zh-Hans: 妈，可以借你的笔电吗？我的坏了，今晚要把历史作业做完。

t: OK, but I need it back by nine.
lines.plain: OK, but I need it back by nine.
lines.kana: OK, but I need it back by nine.
lines.zh: 好，但九點前要還我。
lines.en: OK, but I need it back by nine.
lines.zh-Hans: 好，但九点前要还我。

t: Why does the boy want the laptop?
ask.plain: Why does the boy want the laptop?
ask.en: Why does the boy want the laptop?

explain.zh: 「今晚要把歷史作業做完」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「今晚要把历史作业做完」。

t: You will hear a man leaving a message.
lines.plain: You will hear a man leaving a message.
lines.kana: You will hear a man leaving a message.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一位男士留言。
lines.en: You will hear a man leaving a message.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一位男士留言。

t: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?
lines.plain: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?
lines.kana: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?
lines.zh: 露西，我是丹。我沒辦法四點在咖啡店跟你見面，火車誤點了。改成五點好嗎？地點一樣。
lines.en: Hi Lucy, it's Dan. I can't meet you at the café at four — my train is late. Can we meet at five instead, at the same place?
lines.zh-Hans: 露西，我是丹。我没办法四点在咖啡店跟你见面，火车误点了。改成五点好吗？地点一样。

t: What does Dan want to change?
ask.plain: What does Dan want to change?
ask.en: What does Dan want to change?

explain.zh: 四點改成五點，「地點一樣」：改的是時間。
explain.en: Four to five, same place: the time.
explain.zh-Hans: 四点改成五点，「地点一样」：改的是时间。

t: You will hear two friends talking about a party.
lines.plain: You will hear two friends talking about a party.
lines.kana: You will hear two friends talking about a party.
lines.zh: 你會聽到兩個朋友談一個派對。
lines.en: You will hear two friends talking about a party.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到两个朋友谈一个派对。

t: Are you going to Tom's party?
lines.plain: Are you going to Tom's party?
lines.kana: Are you going to Tom's party?
lines.zh: 你要去湯姆的派對嗎？
lines.en: Are you going to Tom's party?
lines.zh-Hans: 你要去汤姆的派对吗？

t: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.
lines.plain: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.
lines.kana: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.
lines.zh: 很想去，可是那個週末我爺爺奶奶要來，所以得待在家。
lines.en: I'd love to, but my grandparents are visiting that weekend, so I have to stay at home.
lines.zh-Hans: 很想去，可是那个周末我爷爷奶奶要来，所以得待在家。

t: Why can't the boy go to the party?
ask.plain: Why can't the boy go to the party?
ask.zh: 男孩為什麼不能去派對？
ask.en: Why can't the boy go to the party?
ask.zh-Hans: 男孩为什么不能去派对？

t: He has to see his family.
options.plain: He has to see his family.

explain.zh: 「爺爺奶奶要來，所以得待在家」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「爷爷奶奶要来，所以得待在家」。

t: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.
lines.plain: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.
lines.kana: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.
lines.zh: 你會聽到一個女孩談她的新嗜好。
lines.en: You will hear a girl talking about her new hobby.
lines.zh-Hans: 你会听到一个女孩谈她的新嗜好。

t: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.
lines.plain: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.
lines.kana: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.
lines.zh: 我去年開始拍照，大多拍動物，尤其是鳥。下個月我要參加比賽。
lines.en: I started taking photos last year. I mostly take pictures of animals, especially birds. Next month I'm entering a competition.
lines.zh-Hans: 我去年开始拍照，大多拍动物，尤其是鸟。下个月我要参加比赛。

t: What does the girl usually take photos of?
ask.plain: What does the girl usually take photos of?
ask.en: What does the girl usually take photos of?

explain.zh: 「大多拍動物，尤其是鳥」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「大多拍动物，尤其是鸟」。

t: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?
lines.plain: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?
lines.kana: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?
lines.zh: 那麼，星期天的野餐大家要帶什麼？
lines.en: So, what's everyone bringing to the picnic on Sunday?
lines.zh-Hans: 那么，星期天的野餐大家要带什么？

t: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.
lines.plain: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.
lines.kana: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.
lines.zh: 安娜說她要烤蛋糕，她很會烤。
lines.en: Well, Anna said she'd bake a cake — she's really good at that.
lines.zh-Hans: 安娜说她要烤蛋糕，她很会烤。

t: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.
lines.plain: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.
lines.kana: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.
lines.zh: 太好了。班呢？他通常帶飲料。
lines.en: Lovely. What about Ben? He usually brings drinks.
lines.zh-Hans: 太好了。班呢？他通常带饮料。

t: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.
lines.plain: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.
lines.kana: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.
lines.zh: 這次不是。他星期六要去市場，所以會買水果。
lines.en: Not this time. He's going to the market on Saturday, so he'll get some fruit.
lines.zh-Hans: 这次不是。他星期六要去市场，所以会买水果。

lines.plain: OK. And Chloe?
lines.kana: OK. And Chloe?
lines.zh: 好。克蘿伊呢？
lines.en: OK. And Chloe?
lines.zh-Hans: 好。克萝伊呢？

t: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.
lines.plain: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.
lines.kana: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.
lines.zh: 克蘿伊本來想帶冰淇淋，可是會融化，所以改做一大盤沙拉。
lines.en: Chloe wanted to bring ice cream, but it would melt, so she's making a big salad instead.
lines.zh-Hans: 克萝伊本来想带冰淇淋，可是会融化，所以改做一大盘沙拉。

t: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?
lines.plain: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?
lines.kana: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?
lines.zh: 好主意。那大衛帶飲料嗎？
lines.en: Good idea. Is David bringing the drinks, then?
lines.zh-Hans: 好主意。那大卫带饮料吗？

t: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.
lines.plain: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.
lines.kana: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.
lines.zh: 對，檸檬汽水和水。艾拉說她要幫大家做三明治。
lines.en: Yes — lemonade and water. And Ella said she'd make sandwiches for everyone.
lines.zh-Hans: 对，柠檬汽水和水。艾拉说她要帮大家做三明治。

t: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.
lines.plain: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.
lines.kana: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.
lines.zh: 太好了，那我帶麵包和起司。
lines.en: Great. Then I'll bring some bread and cheese.
lines.zh-Hans: 太好了，那我带面包和起司。

explain.zh: 「安娜說她要烤蛋糕」。
explain.zh-Hans: 「安娜说她要烤蛋糕」。

explain.zh: 班通常帶飲料，「這次不是」，他會買水果。
explain.zh-Hans: 班通常带饮料，「这次不是」，他会买水果。

explain.zh: 冰淇淋會融化，「改做一大盤沙拉」。
explain.zh-Hans: 冰淇淋会融化，「改做一大盘沙拉」。

explain.zh: 大衛帶「檸檬汽水和水」。
explain.zh-Hans: 大卫带「柠檬汽水和水」。

explain.zh: 「艾拉說她要幫大家做三明治」；麵包和起司是女的要帶的。
explain.en: Sandwiches; the bread and cheese are the woman's.
explain.zh-Hans: 「艾拉说她要帮大家做三明治」；面包和起司是女的要带的。
